cyberark_epm_raw.dataset_description: CyberArk Endpoint Privilege Manager (EPM) is an endpoint security solution that enforces least privilege and application control.

Description.field_description: The description of the EPM administrative action.

PermissionDescription.field_description: Description of the permission held by the EPM administrator who performed the action.

Role.field_description: The EPM role assigned to the administrator who performed the action.

SetName.field_description: The name of the EPM set in which the administrative action was performed.

Administrator.field_description: The user principal name of the EPM administrator who performed the action.

InternalSessionId.field_description: The internal EPM ID of the administrator session in which the action was performed.

Feature.field_description: The EPM feature or area through which the administrative action was performed.

LoggedFrom.field_description: The IP address from which the EPM administrator performed the action.

accessAction.field_description: Indicates whether EPM took an access action.

userName.field_description: The domain-qualified name of the user who initiated the activity.

operatingSystemType.field_description: The operating system type of the endpoint on which the EPM agent recorded the activity.

winEventType.field_description: The Windows event type code associated with the EPM event.

fileName.field_description: The file name of the application involved in the EPM event.

packageName.field_description: The name of the application package that the file involved in the EPM event belongs to.

policyName.field_description: The name of the EPM policy that matched the application and determined the action taken.

publisher.field_description: The publisher (vendor or company) of the application involved in the EPM event.

eventType.field_description: The type of EPM event recorded for the application.

filePath.field_description: The full file path of the application executable involved in the EPM event.

runAsUsername.field_description: The user name of the account under which the application was run.

sourceProcessUsername.field_description: The user name of the account that ran the source process that started the application.

fileSize.field_description: The size of the application file involved in the EPM event, in kilobytes.

threatProtectionAction.field_description: The threat protection action setting EPM applied to the event.

productName.field_description: The product name of the application.

bundleName.field_description: The name of the macOS application bundle that contains the file involved in the event.

productVersion.field_description: The product version of the application.

bundleVersion.field_description: The version of the macOS application bundle that contains the file involved in the event.

originUserUID.field_description: The unique ID of the user who initiated the activity on the endpoint.

accessTargetType.field_description: The type of resource the application attempted to access.

accessTargetName.field_description: The name of the resource the application attempted to access.

sourceProcessCommandLine.field_description: The command line of the source process that started the application.

processCommandLine.field_description: The command line used to run the application process recorded by EPM.

sourceProcessHash.field_description: The hash of the source process executable that started the application.

sourceProcessSigner.field_description: The signer of the source process executable that started the application.

sourceWSName.field_description: The name of the source workstation from which the activity originated.

computerName.field_description: The host name of the endpoint on which the EPM agent recorded the activity.

sourceWSIp.field_description: The IP address of the source workstation from which the activity originated.

winEventRecordId.field_description: The record ID of the Windows event associated with the EPM event.

agentId.field_description: The ID of the EPM agent on the endpoint that recorded the activity.

logonAttemptTypeId.field_description: The numeric Windows logon type of the logon attempt recorded by EPM.

logonStatusId.field_description: The numeric Windows status code that indicates the result of the logon attempt.

policyAction.field_description: The action the EPM policy applied to the application.

commandInfo.field_description: The command line of the application process recorded in the EPM policy audit.

source_log_type.field_description: The event type of the EPM record.
